fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-03-13, the complainant reported that a boundary wall near Nallur Park Main Street in Chennai was extended into the land of the complainant without permission. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-03-10 at approximately 13:40. Rajeshwari Ammal reported the matter orally at Chennai North PS; the contact number given was 9000000242. Siva Selvam (9000000440), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. Murugan Sundaram (mobile 9000000207) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00294, as the mobile number 9000000207 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Encroachment reportedly began after a dispute over survey records.
fields.Keywords: land encroachment, boundary dispute, afternoon, associate, suspect, mobile number, main street, photograph
